content: While these knowledge bases provide semantically rich and fine-granular classes and relationship types, the task of entity classification often requires associating coarse-grained classes with discovered surface forms of entities. Most existing studies consider NER and entity linking as two separate tasks, whereas we try to combine the two. It has been shown that one can significantly increase the semantic information carried by a NER system when we successfully linking entities from a deep learning method to the related entities from a knowledge base BIBREF26 , BIBREF27 .
